entries.title: Automatic counts a Mac's inactive memory
entries.body: A Mac at normal memory pressure now counts inactive memory as room. A task in a project set to Automatic can start on this Mac when that memory can be reclaimed, and still waits when macOS warns that memory is tight.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new on screen: a task starts on this Mac, or waits with the same words, with no new layout.
